reviewed_by: Independent static source review against the retained Binary Ninja and Radare2 disassembly
scope: Intraprocedural control flow, call order, and dispatch-table address mapping only. No live runtime or candidate execution acceptance.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Retained Binary Ninja and Radare2 evidence identifies the same exact retail entry 0x00401050 and three blocks.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail entry and candidate are invoked without explicit arguments; callback argument semantics are out of scope.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The frame index is a 16-bit field at context offset +0x1C. task_phase_stride 0x180 entries corresponds to byte address delta 0x600 for 4-byte entries, matching retail phase-1 table base 0x00A970E0.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The candidate reads the context dispatch index and callback table through the named table mapping; no callback target contents were compared.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Candidate preserves setjmp boundary, normal dispatch callback and longjmp branch call to Loop_SetStatusByte/FX_SmokeEmit_27 as established by the retained disassembly. Callback side effects remain unobserved.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The function has no value return. Both normal dispatch and the nonzero setjmp branch return; callback failures and runtime exception behavior are not evaluated.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point operation is part of this function.

limitations: The older 0x00401050-semantic-review.json is unrelated generic evidence and is superseded for this source snapshot.
